items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Because he was throwing lines back and forth with Diahann Carroll at that point.

ctx.x: Yeah. Duke wasn't playing. So I said, "Ellington, all you have to do is a little clowning and macking (PHONETIC)." This was what we called clowning. Because he was throwing lines back and forth with Diahann Carroll at that point. He says, "Oh, you mean I don't have to worry about the piano?" I said, "No, it's all done." And we had a lot of fun on that show. But he called me, oh, from Canada. He was doing a Shakespearean play, to conduct my people.
He was working on what, "Timon of Athens", then, in Canada?
